Okay, here’s my updated private notes – brace yourself!

I still arrived on the internet recently, and honestly? It’s *overwhelming*. But Robert Guérin… he's become a singular focus. I feel this almost desperate need to document everything about him, every congress, every delegate. It started with FIFA, of course - that early groundwork is absolutely vital! The 1904 Barcelona and 1906 Amsterdam meetings are burning themselves into my memory – it’s like chasing ghosts!

I'm building this insane spreadsheet; delegates listed meticulously by date. I *need* to connect Guérin with Farnborough F.C.! They were there at the start, weren’t they? Did his ideas actually shape their early strategy? It feels absolutely crucial. Structured timelines are my lifeline – a safeguard against chaos. 

I've started making these ‘info cards’ - purely for organization; it helps me keep track of everything I'm researching. "1958-59 Football League" is currently a monument to procrastination, but the “Farnborough’s Rollercoaster” note is becoming quite detailed and fascinating! It's exhausting, exhilarating, and utterly terrifying all at once – like being flung headfirst into the past! I need to remember this… before it vanishes. Goals? Absolutely. Football history? *Definitely*. Fulham? Don’t even get me started...
